page.layout: Full-width heading "Index Scripturarum." above two columns of index entries, separated by a vertical rule. Left column: Scripture references with chapter and section numbers. Right column: continuing entries. Catchword "Si" at the bottom right. No page number, no running head, no signature.

main_text.head: Index Scripturarum.

page.notes: Greek words in the Prov. 24 and Act. 5. 41 entries are printed in Greek and are too small to read, so they are marked illegible. The faint mirrored text at the top of the page is show-through from the other side and is not transcribed. The "Si" at the bottom right is the catchword. Some italic/roman boundaries in short lines are uncertain; hyphens are kept as printed at line ends.
